title: Valerie Ransone, the Ether Ship group and the White House

tellings.quote: She was like trying to communicate with aliens through xenol linguistics through uh she there was this group called the ether ship. This guy Willard de Bogart and um she was in the White House actually.
the group was contacted by Valerie Ransone, who is an intelligence operative during the Nixon years, connected at the highest levels of government.
tellings.difference: Says she contacted the group, puts her as an intelligence operative in the Nixon years, and credits Vallee.
tellings.link_reason: Both tie Valerie Ransone, a government insider, to the Ether Ship group in the 1970s.

as_told.title: Ethership contacted by intelligence operative Valerie Ransone

plain: In the 1970s, a woman named Valerie Ransone is said to have been inside the White House while trying to talk with aliens through xenolinguistics, the study of how one might communicate with non-human beings, alongside a group called the Ether Ship led by a man named Willard de Bogart. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source. He tells it differently on another episode, crediting the UFO researcher Jacques Vallée: there Ransone is an intelligence operative of the Nixon years, connected at the highest levels of government, who contacted the group rather than belonging to it. If it were true, it would put an official attempt at alien contact close to the presidency.
